ring2_rationale.win: Heavy-duty turbines sold out: overflow to aero/industrial turbines (Baker Hughes); existing dispatchable fleets (Vistra, Talen) gain scarcity value.
ring2_rationale.lose: Turbine scarcity raises the cost and delay of new gas build for large utility developers (NextEra) — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Vertiv backlog and guide up confirm data-center power/cooling demand for peers (Eaton, nVent).
ring2_rationale.lose: Vertiv winning share in data-center power/cooling competes with Schneider — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Electrification orders up on data centers: GOES for transformers (Cleveland-Cliffs, POSCO) and switchgear peer Powell.
ring2_rationale.lose: ABB taking data-center electrical share competes with Vertiv's power line — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Record transmission backlog pulls cable (Prysmian, Nexans, NKT) and grid hardware (Hubbell).
ring2_rationale.lose: Contractor capacity booked to record levels raises build cost and time for utility developers (NextEra) — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Eaton electrical orders up double digits: peer read-through (ABB, Schneider) and transformer steel (Cleveland-Cliffs).
ring2_rationale.lose: Eaton taking data-center electrical content competes with nVent — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Tight fuel with firm contracting signals new reactor demand: components (BWXT), forgings (Doosan).
ring2_rationale.lose: Higher realized uranium prices raise fuel cost for nuclear operators (Constellation, Talen) — small share of cost, weak.

ring2_rationale.win: New hyperscaler nuclear PPAs pull fuel (Centrus, Cameco) and grid/turbine work (GE Vernova).
ring2_rationale.lose: Hyperscalers contracting firm nuclear instead of renewables PPAs shifts demand away from NextEra.

ring2_rationale.win: Vistra PPA progress pulls enrichment (Centrus) and gas turbines (GE Vernova).
ring2_rationale.lose: Firm-power PPAs rather than renewable PPAs shift demand away from NextEra.

ring2_rationale.win: Record grid backlog pulls transformer steel (Cleveland-Cliffs, POSCO) and HVDC cable (Prysmian).
ring2_rationale.lose: Grid-equipment backlog at a record lengthens interconnection for new generation (NextEra) — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: HALEU contract or DOE milestone unlocks fuel for advanced reactors (Oklo, Nano Nuclear) and fuel fabrication (BWXT).
ring2_rationale.lose: Higher enrichment pricing raises fuel cost for nuclear operators (Constellation) — small share of cost, weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Cable book-to-bill above 1 confirms HVDC demand: peer NKT and transmission builder Quanta.
ring2_rationale.lose: Sold-out HVDC cable delays offshore and interconnection projects for developers (NextEra) — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: A North American GOES expansion eases transformer-steel supply for Eaton and ABB transformer lines.
ring2_rationale.lose: Domestic steel capacity eases distribution-transformer scarcity premium for utility hardware (Hubbell) — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: A firm SMR order/approval/award pulls HALEU (Centrus), components (BWXT), forgings (Doosan), and EPC (Fluor).
ring2_rationale.lose: SMRs advancing compete with gas turbines for firm data-center power — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Powell record switchgear orders: read-through to electrical peers (Eaton, ABB, Hubbell).
ring2_rationale.lose: Powell winning large data-center E-house orders competes with Schneider — weak.
